items.source: @ModelAttribute can also be used to expose reference data to a web view by annotating accessor methods in a controller class with @RequestMapping methods. Such accessor methods are allowed to have any arguments that @RequestMapping methods support, returning the model attribute value to expose.
items.translation: `@ModelAttribute` 也可用于通过注解控制器类中的访问器方法来向 Web 视图暴露引用数据，这些访问器方法使用支持 `@RequestMapping` 方法的注解。此类访问器方法可以拥有 `@RequestMapping` 方法支持的任何参数，并返回要暴露的模型属性值。

items.source: Note however that reference data and all other model content are not available to web views when request processing results in an Exception since the exception could be raised at any time making the content of the model unreliable. For this reason @ExceptionHandler methods do not provide access to a Model argument.
items.translation: 不过请注意，当请求处理导致抛出 `Exception` 时，引用数据及其他所有模型内容对 Web 视图均不可用，因为异常可能在任何时刻被抛出，从而导致模型内容不可靠。因此，@ExceptionHandler 方法不提供 `Model` 参数的访问权限。

items.source: @ModelAttribute can be used to expose command objects to a web view, using specific attribute names, by annotating corresponding parameters of an @RequestMapping method.
items.translation: @ModelAttribute 可用于通过注解 @RequestMapping 方法的相应参数，使用特定的属性名将命令对象暴露给 Web 视图。

items.source: By default this is set to true in which case data binding applies. Set this to false to disable data binding.
items.translation: 默认情况下，此值设置为 `true`，此时会应用数据绑定。将其设置为 `false` 可禁用数据绑定。

items.source:
The default model attribute name is inferred from the declared
attribute type (i.e. the method parameter type or method return type),
based on the non-qualified class name:
for example, "orderAddress" for class "mypackage.OrderAddress",
or "orderAddressList" for "List<mypackage.OrderAddress>".
items.translation: 默认模型属性名称是根据声明的属性类型（即方法参数类型或方法返回类型）推断得出的，基于非限定类名：例如，对于类 "mypackage.OrderAddress" 为 "orderAddress"，或者对于 "List<mypackage.OrderAddress>" 为 "orderAddressList"。

items.source: WARNING: Data binding can lead to security issues by exposing parts of the object graph that are not meant to be accessed or modified by external clients. Therefore the design and use of data binding should be considered carefully with regard to security. For more details, please refer to the dedicated sections on data binding for Spring Web MVC and Spring WebFlux in the reference manual.
items.translation: 警告： 数据绑定可能导致安全问题，因为它会暴露外部客户端不应访问或修改的对象图部分。因此，在设计和使用数据绑定时应仔细考虑安全性问题。有关详细信息，请参阅参考手册中关于 Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux 的数据绑定专用章节： Spring Web MVC 和 Spring WebFlux。

items.source: Allows data binding to be disabled directly on an @ModelAttribute method parameter or on the attribute returned from an @ModelAttribute method, both of which would prevent data binding for that attribute.
items.translation: 允许直接在 `@ModelAttribute` 方法参数或从 `@ModelAttribute` 方法返回的属性上禁用数据绑定，这两种方式都会阻止对该属性的数据绑定。

items.source: The name of the model attribute to bind to.
items.translation: 要绑定的模型属性名称。

items.source: Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze
items.translation: Juergen Hoeller, Rossen Stoyanchev, Sebastien Deleuze
